capabilities: push local vault files to an SFTP server
pull files from the SFTP server on open or on demand
configure host, port, credentials and remote vault path
extras: The README warns that syncing is destructive on the SFTP side: local file changes move replaced remote files, and local originals go to the .trash folder.
problem: Obsidian Sync is a hosted service, and some users want to sync their vault to their own FTP/SFTP server instead.
summary: Plugin that pushes and pulls vault files to a personal SFTP server, with optional SOCKS proxy support.
